source: NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM), CONUS core QPF
units: mm liquid-water equivalent per Connecticut calendar day
limitations: Native NBM grid sampled at each mapped parcel representative point; mapped fields are candidates, not confirmed farm boundaries.

NBM supplies direct QPF only through the available 264-hour forecast. Final three days are a 50/50 extension of its preceding three-day mean and the trailing 42-day PRISM farm mean; that extension is not a weather-model forecast and has no calibrated uncertainty interval.
Local calendar-day totals are aggregated from GRIB accumulation intervals; missing intervals are never treated as zero.
correction_reason: Reissued after identifying and excluding incomplete local NBM calendar-day totals; original retained.
